blurb: Afternoon pickup, after lunch, allows you to enjoy your morning without being rushed. There are no long drives. We get right to the best part, site seeing and wine tasting. We will take you on a short drive to the Kelowna Wine Route or the West Kelowna Wine Route. For wine enthusiasts, the vineyards around Kelowna produce a diversity of wines that are well worth tasting. Try sampling your favorite varietals on this guided tour, where you pick an area to explore, and enjoy comfortable travel by Mercedes van. Decide between two tasting routes—visit the Kelowna wineries and enjoy Okanagan Lake and city views, or try the popular West Kelowna vineyards around Mount Boucherie, which are known for their volcanic soil with lake views. Our tour will take up to 4 hours. Tour includes transportation to wineries in a Mercedes Benz tour bus. Tasting fees at the winery are included in your tour fee.
